cohort: 680 birth records between October and December 2018 in the Ho Municipality of Ghana
finding: Maternal age, parity, number of antenatal care visits, hypertension, SP/IPTp, and caesarean section were independently associated with low birth weight and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section significantly increased the odds of both low birth weight and preterm delivery.
birth_weight: Babies with low birth weight (<2500g) were included as an outcome.
